codes.label: Equity option value
codes.definition: Whether startup stock options are realistically worth anything, judged by share count, strike price, vesting, valuation, dilution, exercise window and tax treatment, and so whether to discount them to near zero or treat them as a lottery ticket.

codes.label: Employer financial runway
codes.definition: How long the small company can survive, based on funding stage, recent rounds, cash runway, revenue and profitability, since failure would erase the salary and equity gains.

codes.label: Personal financial cushion
codes.definition: Whether she has enough savings and fixed obligations she can cover to absorb a sudden layoff or job loss at the new employer.

codes.label: Job security comparison
codes.definition: How stable the established current employer is versus the new employer or role, including layoff, restructuring and acquisition risk.

codes.label: Total compensation beyond base pay
codes.definition: Comparing full packages, including bonus, retirement match, health insurance, paid leave and other benefits, rather than relying on the headline salary difference.

codes.label: Net take-home after real costs
codes.definition: Adjusting the raise for taxes, loan repayment effects, housing and cost-of-living differences, commuting, relocation and home-office costs to see the true gain.

codes.label: Deadline as pressure and information
codes.definition: Treating a short decision deadline as a possible pressure tactic and as a signal of how the company treats people, and asking for an extension to do due diligence.

codes.label: Negotiating terms with the new employer
codes.definition: Using the window to ask for a higher base, more equity, a signing bonus, relocation support, flexible or hybrid arrangements, a later start date or written terms.

codes.label: Leverage with current employer
codes.definition: Using the outside offer to seek a raise, retention package, new title or internal path, and deciding in advance whether he or she would genuinely accept a counteroffer.

codes.label: Verifying the promotion hint
codes.definition: Asking the manager whether a vague promotion hint is real, with title, salary range and timeline in writing, before letting it weigh against a concrete offer.

codes.label: Student loan repayment situation
codes.definition: How the loan balance interacts with cash flow, income-driven repayment, employer assistance, and the need for a predictable income.

codes.label: Public service loan forgiveness eligibility
codes.definition: Whether a nonprofit or qualifying current employer makes her eligible for loan forgiveness that a for-profit startup would forfeit.

codes.label: Career growth and skill development
codes.definition: Which environment builds broader responsibility, faster learning and a stronger long-term resume, versus structured advancement and depth in the current setting.

codes.label: Domain expertise portability
codes.definition: Whether specialized domain experience (such as healthcare data) is a scarce credential that transfers poorly, and which domain positions her better for future roles.

codes.label: Remote work trade-offs
codes.definition: The savings and flexibility of fully remote work weighed against isolation, less mentorship, reduced visibility for promotion and possible later changes to the policy.

codes.label: Risk tolerance and life stage
codes.definition: Her lack of dependents and early career stage give more capacity to absorb risk, versus the higher cost of a failed move at a later age.

codes.label: Personal preferences and fit
codes.definition: What kind of work, pace, culture and mission she values and finds energizing, including tolerance for ambiguity versus preference for stability.

codes.label: Company culture and leadership check
codes.definition: Evaluating the employer's culture, leadership, turnover and benefits by talking to current employees and reviewing details of the offer.

codes.label: Pension vesting cliff
codes.definition: The pension fully vests in about a year, so leaving now may forfeit a large retirement benefit, and he should get the exact benefit value and compare it to the raise or ask for a delayed start.

codes.label: Spouse's career and household role
codes.definition: His wife's local teaching job, seniority, benefits and willingness to move make the decision a joint one, requiring her to be a full partner.

codes.label: Youngest child's schooling disruption
codes.definition: Moving a high school junior would disrupt the final school years, friendships and college applications, so timing relative to graduation matters.

codes.label: Commute versus relocation burden
codes.definition: A two-hour distance forces a choice between a long daily commute or a move, each with real costs in time, fatigue, fuel, health, safety and family presence.

codes.label: Relocation and housing costs
codes.definition: Selling a home or breaking a lease, moving costs and the cost of living and housing in the new area can erode the raise.

codes.label: Competitor stability and role scope
codes.definition: The financial health, leadership stability and reason for the opening at the competitor, plus the real scope, authority, reporting line and contract protections of the director role.

codes.label: Non-compete and confidentiality exposure
codes.definition: Checking non-compete, non-solicitation and confidentiality obligations, since a competitor may be hiring him for his knowledge of current processes.

codes.label: Desire for the director work itself
codes.definition: Whether he actually wants the director's day-to-day work, including less hands-on involvement and more budgeting, politics and after-hours demands, rather than just the title and pay.

codes.label: Director role career runway at 52
codes.definition: How many working years remain, whether the title opens real future options or retirement benefits, and how recoverable a failed move would be at his age.

codes.label: Identity, loyalty and local capital
codes.definition: After nineteen years, his professional reputation, relationships and sense of identity are concentrated locally, so he should ask whether he is moving toward something or away from restlessness.

codes.label: Family time and well-being demands
codes.definition: The new role's workload, travel and after-hours expectations could affect his health, energy and time with family.

codes.label: Own goals and wife's preferences
codes.definition: Clarifying what he wants from the next career phase and weighing his wife's long-term goals, retirement plans and college costs for the children.

codes.label: Reversibility of the move
codes.definition: How easily the decision can be undone, such as returning to the previous employer or re-entering the market if the new job fails.
